entries.title: Psalms 65:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David. A Song.> It is right for you, O God, to have praise in Zion: to you let the offering be made.

entries.title: Psalms 65:2
segments: To you, O hearer of prayer, let the words of all flesh come.

entries.title: Psalms 65:3
segments: Evils have overcome us: but as for our sins, you will take them away.

entries.title: Psalms 65:4
segments: Happy is the man of your selection, to whom you give a resting-place in your house; we will be full of the good things out of your holy place.

entries.title: Psalms 65:5
segments: You will give us an answer in righteousness by great acts of power, O God of our salvation; you who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, and of the far-off lands of the sea;

entries.title: Psalms 65:6
segments: ¶The God by whose strength the mountains are fixed; who is robed with power:

entries.title: Psalms 65:7
segments: Who makes the loud voice of the sea quiet, and puts an end to the sound of its waves.

entries.title: Psalms 65:8
segments: Those in the farthest parts of the earth have fear when they see your signs: the outgoings of the morning and evening are glad because of you.

entries.title: Psalms 65:9
segments: You have given your blessing to the earth, watering it and making it fertile; the river of God is full of water: and having made it ready, you give men grain.

entries.title: Psalms 65:10
segments: You make the ploughed lands full of water; you make smooth the slopes: you make the earth soft with showers, sending your blessing on its growth.

entries.title: Psalms 65:11
segments: The year is crowned with the good you give; life-giving rain is dropping from your footsteps,

entries.title: Psalms 65:12
segments: Falling on the grass of the waste land: and the little hills are glad on every side.

entries.title: Psalms 65:13
segments: The grass-land is thick with flocks; the valleys are full of grain; they give glad cries and songs of joy.
